scientific_limitations_and_integrity: A complete arbitrary-prime-power proof is given for ordered labeled M2 pairs, with finite exhaustive checks in fields of sizes 2,3,4,5. The novelty assessment applies to targetwise nonzero fibers, not preexisting zero-fiber enumeration. Equivalent difference-of-squares and characteristic-two commutator formulations may have unlocated priority; no independence or complete literature certification is claimed.
title: Prescribed-output fibers of the two-by-two matrix anticommutator over every finite field
